  obtain ⟨o,htree,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h

def Bounded (q : Queries) : Prop := ∀ x ∈ q.val, x.val < 262144

theorem mask (x : U32) : (x &&& 262143#u32).val < 262144 := by
  rw [UScalar.val_and]
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt Nat.and_le_right (by decide)

theorem set_bounded (xs : List U32) (i : Nat) (x : U32)
    (hx : x.val < 262144) (hs : ∀ y ∈ xs, y.val < 262144) :
    ∀ y ∈ xs.set i x, y.val < 262144 := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp only [List.set_nil, List.not_mem_nil, false_implies, implies_true]
  | cons a xs ih =>
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      intro y hy
      simp only [List.set_cons_zero, List.mem_cons] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | hy
      · exact hx
      · exact hs y (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hy)
    | succ i =>
      intro y hy
      simp only [List.set_cons_succ, List.mem_cons] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | hy
      · exact hs _ (List.mem_cons_self)
      · exact ih i (fun z hz => hs z (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hz)) y hy

theorem update (q : Queries) (i : Usize) (x : U32) (hq : Bounded q)
    (hx : x.val < 262144) : Post Bounded (Array.update q i x) := by
  intro out h
  unfold Array.update at h
  split at h
  · cases h
  · cases h
    exact set_bounded q.val i.val x hx hq

theorem initial : Bounded (Array.repeat 22#usize 0#u32) := by
  intro x hx
  have h : x = 0#u32 := (by simpa only [Array.repeat, List.mem_replicate] using hx : (22#usize).val ≠ 0 ∧ x = 0#u32).2
  rw [h]
  decide

/-- Reachability facts only: no model Data/Plan or serializer conclusion. -/
def Trace (hash : Hash) (prepared : prover.PreparedOpening)
    (salts : host_commitment.PrivateSalts)
    (round : Result (Array W 7#usize))
    (fold : W → Result (alloc.vec.Vec W)) (p : prover.Publication) : Prop :=
  ∃ (leaves : alloc.vec.Vec (Array U8 32#usize)) (o : Option host_tree.BinaryTree) (tree : host_tree.BinaryTree)
    (root : Array U8 32#usize) (second : Array W 7#usize)
    (cbytes payload0 payload : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (alpha : W)
    (transcript : host_transcript.Transcript aspis_core.digest.LegacyHashFn)
    (final : alloc.vec.Vec W) (fbytes : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (queries : Array U32 22#usize)
    (next : host_transcript.Transcript aspis_core.digest.LegacyHashFn),
    prover.folded_leaves hash (alloc.vec.Vec.deref prepared.folded_word) salts=ok leaves ∧
    host_tree.BinaryTree.new aspis_core.digest.LegacyHashFn.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 hash leaves=ok o ∧
    core.option.Option.ok_or o verifier.Error.Allocation=ok (.Ok tree) ∧
    host_tree.BinaryTree.root tree=ok root ∧ round=ok second ∧
    prover.encoded_slice second.to_slice=ok cbytes ∧
    alloc.slice.Slice.to_vec core.clone.CloneU8 root.to_slice=ok payload0 ∧
    alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 payload0 (alloc.vec.Vec.deref cbytes)=ok payload ∧
    host_transcript.Transcript.scalar aspis_core.digest.LegacyHashFn.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32
      prepared.transcript 30#u8 (alloc.vec.Vec.deref payload) false=ok (alpha,transcript) ∧
    fold alpha=ok final ∧ prover.encoded_slice (alloc.vec.Vec.deref final)=ok fbytes ∧
    host_transcript.Transcript.queries aspis_core.digest.LegacyHashFn.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32
      transcript 31#u8 (alloc.vec.Vec.deref fbytes)=ok (.Ok queries,next) ∧
    p=⟨prepared.backend,prepared.sem.bytes,prepared.y1,prepared.inactive,
       prepared.c0bytes,root,cbytes,fbytes,queries,prepared.folded_word,salts,tree⟩

theorem run (variant : transport.Variant)
    (hash : Slice (Slice U8) → Result (Array U8 32#usize))
    (prepared : prover.PreparedOpening) (salts : host_commitment.PrivateSalts)
    (round : Result (Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 7#usize))
    (fold : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact → Result (alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact))
    (p : prover.Publication)
    (h : PV_RunJoin_FinishContext47.run variant hash prepared salts round fold=ok (.Ok p)) :
    Trace hash prepared salts round fold p := by
  unfold PV_RunJoin_FinishContext47.run at h
  obtain ⟨leaves,hleaves,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
  obtain ⟨o,htree,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
  obtain ⟨r,hr,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
  cases r with
  | Err e => cases h
  | Ok tree =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨root,hroot,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
    obtain ⟨second,hsecond,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
    simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨cbytes,hcbytes,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
    obtain ⟨payload,hpayload,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
    obtain ⟨payload1,hpayload1,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
    obtain ⟨pair,halpha,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
    rcases pair with ⟨alpha,transcript⟩
    obtain ⟨final,hfinal,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
    obtain ⟨fbytes,hfbytes,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
    obtain ⟨pair,hqueries,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
    rcases pair with ⟨r,next⟩
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair] at h
    cases r with
    | Err e => cases h
    | Ok queries =>
      try simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok,lift] at h
      obtain ⟨tag32,htag32,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
      obtain ⟨z0,hz0,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
      obtain ⟨z1,hz1,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
      obtain ⟨v,hv,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
      obtain ⟨root0,hroot0,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
      obtain ⟨checked,hchecked,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
      cases checked with
      | Err e => cases h
      | Ok unit =>
        try simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
        cases h
        exact ⟨leaves,o,tree,root,second,cbytes,payload,payload1,alpha,transcript,
          final,fbytes,queries,next,hleaves,htree,hr,hroot,hsecond,hcbytes,hpayload,hpayload1,
          halpha,hfinal,hfbytes,hqueries,rfl⟩

theorem source (variant : transport.Variant) (hash : Hash)
    (prepared : prover.PreparedOpening) (salts : host_commitment.PrivateSalts)

variable [ExternalTypes] [ExternalFuns]
def Good (r : Output) : Prop := match r with
  | .Ok (q,_) => Bounded q
  | .Err _ => True

theorem dispatch (blocks advances : Blocks) (accepted : Queries) (n draws : Usize)
    (recur : Queries → Usize → Usize → Result Output)
    (hq : Bounded accepted)
    (hr : ∀ a m d, Bounded a → Post Good (recur a m d)) :
    Post Good (ProverRwQueryScan.dispatch recur blocks advances accepted n draws) := by
  unfold ProverRwQueryScan.dispatch
  split
  · split
    · apply bind_right; intro a
      exact ok Good _ hq
    · exact ok Good _ True.intro
  · apply bind_right; intro k
    split
    · apply bind_right; intro a
      exact ok Good _ hq
    · simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
      apply bind_right; intro i
      apply bind_right; intro a
      apply bind_right; intro b0
      apply bind_right; intro b1
      apply bind_right; intro b2
      apply bind_right; intro b3
      apply bind_right; intro duplicate
      split
      · exact hr _ _ _ hq
      · apply bind_known Good Bounded _ _ (update _ _ _ hq (mask _))
        intro updated hu
        exact hr _ _ _ hu

theorem finite (blocks advances : Blocks) (fuel : Nat) (accepted : Queries)
    (n draws : Usize) (hq : Bounded accepted) :
    Post Good (ProverRwQueryScan.finite blocks advances fuel accepted n draws) := by
  induction fuel generalizing accepted n draws with
  | zero =>
    apply dispatch blocks advances accepted n draws _ hq
    intro a m d ha out h
    cases h
  | succ fuel ih =>
    apply dispatch blocks advances accepted n draws _ hq
    exact ih

theorem pairs (blocks advances : Blocks) (q : Queries) (state : Array U8 32#usize)
    (h : host_transcript.queries_from_pairs blocks advances=ok (.Ok (q,state))) :
    Bounded q := by
  rw [queries_finite] at h
  exact finite blocks advances 64 _ _ _ initial _ h

namespace R1Z.PV_RJN_Producers
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull PV_RunJoin_PublishSkeleton54
variable [ExternalTypes] [ExternalFuns]
/-- The plan's literal header and three offsets agree with the constants read
by the native serializer. No publication or assembly equation is assumed. -/
def PV_RJN_Producer_Layout {I : Type} (runs : I → Run) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, ∃ (size openings nodes : Usize) (magic : Array U8 8#usize) (tag : U8),
    compact.PROOF_BYTES=ok size ∧ compact.OFF_OPENINGS=ok openings ∧ compact.OFF_NODES=ok nodes ∧
    compact.MAGIC=ok magic ∧ transport.Variant.tag .S2=ok tag ∧
    (runs i).plan.proofBytes=size.val ∧ (runs i).plan.offOpenings=openings.val ∧
    (runs i).plan.offNodes=nodes.val ∧
    (runs i).plan.header=bytes magic.val++bytes [tag,0#u8,0#u8,0#u8,0#u8,0#u8,0#u8,0#u8]

/-- Room for the two compact front encoders. The remaining append bounds are
recovered from successful source calls, rather than assumed. -/
def PV_RJN_Producer_FrontRoom {I : Type} (runs : I → Run) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, (runs i).plan.header.length+(runs i).plan.semantic.length+(runs i).plan.claim.length≤Usize.max

#print axioms PV_RJN_Producer_Layout
#print axioms PV_RJN_Producer_FrontRoom

/-- Literal plan facts that the actual Data/Plan producer supplies. -/
def PV_RJN_Producer_PlanLayout {I : Type} [ExternalTypes] (runs : I → Run) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, (runs i).plan.proofBytes=57607 ∧ (runs i).plan.offOpenings=10055 ∧

      ProverRwDictionaryLayoutSource.compact.PROOF_BYTES := by

    (ops : @ExternalFuns (types base)) {I : Type} (runs : I → @Run (types base))
    (producer : @PV_RJN_Producer_PlanLayout I (types base) runs) :
    @PV_RJN_Producer_Layout (types base) (selected base heap box ops) I runs := by

    ?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,hsize,hopen,hnodes,hheader⟩
  · change @ExternalFuns.op242 (types base) (selected base heap box ops)=_
    unfold selected

    exact primitive_size ops
  · change @ExternalFuns.op244 (types base) (selected base heap box ops)=_
    unfold selected

def Trace (variant : transport.Variant) (p : prover.Publication) (proof : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ (size openings nodes : Usize) (magic : Array U8 8#usize) (tag : U8)
    (h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8 h9 : V) (ib : Array U8 32#usize)

    (semanticResult valuesResult : core.result.Result Unit compact.CodecError),
    compact.PROOF_BYTES=ok size ∧ compact.MAGIC=ok magic ∧ transport.Variant.tag variant=ok tag ∧
    alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 (alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity U8 size)
      magic.to_slice=ok h0 ∧
    alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 h0
      (Array.make 8#usize [tag,0#u8,0#u8,0#u8,0#u8,0#u8,0#u8,0#u8]).to_slice=ok h1 ∧
    host_compact.compact_semantic (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.semantic_bytes) h1=ok (semanticResult,h2) ∧
    host_compact.compact_values (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.y1) h2=ok (valuesResult,h3) ∧
    aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes p.inactive=ok ib ∧
    alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 h3 ib.to_slice=ok h4 ∧

    alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 h6 (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.c1bytes)=ok h7 ∧
    alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 h7 (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.fbytes)=ok h8 ∧
    compact.OFF_OPENINGS=ok openings ∧ alloc.vec.Vec.len h8=openings ∧
    p.backend.c1=some cc1 ∧ p.backend.c2=some cc2 ∧
    prover.append_query_openings h8 cc1 cc2 p.queries (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.folded_word) p.folded_salts=ok h9 ∧
    compact.OFF_NODES=ok nodes ∧ alloc.vec.Vec.len h9=nodes ∧
    prover.append_node_slots h9 cc1 cc2 p.tree p.queries=ok (.Ok proof) ∧ alloc.vec.Vec.len proof=size

theorem unwrap_success {T : Type} (o : Option T) (x : T)
    (h : core.option.Option.unwrap o=ok x) : o=some x := by
  cases o with
  | none => cases h
  | some a =>
    have he : a=x := Result.ok.inj h
    exact congrArg some he

theorem source (variant : transport.Variant) (p : prover.Publication) (proof : V)
    (h : prover.publish_compact variant p=ok (.Ok proof)) : Trace variant p proof := by
  unfold prover.publish_compact at h
  obtain ⟨size,hsize,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
  obtain ⟨magic,hmagic,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
  try simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨h0,hh0,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
  obtain ⟨tag,htag,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
  try simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨h1,hh1,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
  obtain ⟨pair,hsem,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
  rcases pair with ⟨semanticResult,h2⟩
  obtain ⟨r,hmapped,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
  cases r with
  | Err e => cases h
  | Ok u =>
    cases u
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨pair,hclaim,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
    rcases pair with ⟨valuesResult,h3⟩
    obtain ⟨r,hmapped2,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
    cases r with
    | Err e => cases h
    | Ok u =>
      cases u
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨ib,hib,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
      try simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨h4,hh4,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
      obtain ⟨h5,hh5,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
      try simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨h6,hh6,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
      obtain ⟨h7,hh7,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
      obtain ⟨h8,hh8,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
      obtain ⟨openings,hopen,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
      by_cases hopenlen : alloc.vec.Vec.len h8=openings
      · simp only [massert,hopenlen,if_true,bind_tc_ok] at h
        dsimp only [core.option.Option.take] at h
        obtain ⟨cc1,hc1,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
        obtain ⟨cc2,hc2,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
        have hc1' : p.backend.c1=some cc1 := unwrap_success _ _ hc1
        have hc2' : p.backend.c2=some cc2 := unwrap_success _ _ hc2
        obtain ⟨h9,hh9,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
        obtain ⟨nodes,hnodes,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
        by_cases hnodelen : alloc.vec.Vec.len h9=nodes
        · simp only [massert,hnodelen,if_true,bind_tc_ok] at h
          obtain ⟨r,hn,h⟩ := bind_eq_ok h
          cases r with
          | Err e => cases h
          | Ok val =>
            simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
            by_cases hlen : alloc.vec.Vec.len val=size
            · simp only [massert,hlen,if_true,bind_tc_ok] at h
              cases h
              exact ⟨size,openings,nodes,magic,tag,h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7,h8,h9,ib,cc1,cc2,semanticResult,valuesResult,
                hsize,hmagic,htag,hh0,hh1,hsem,hclaim,hib,hh4,hh5,hh6,hh7,hh8,hopen,hopenlen,
                hc1',hc2',hh9,hnodes,hnodelen,hn,hlen⟩
            · simp only [massert,hlen,if_false] at h; cases h
        · simp only [massert,hnodelen,if_false] at h; cases h
      · simp only [massert,hopenlen,if_false] at h; cases h

theorem actual {I : Type} (runs : I → Run)
    (layout : PV_RJN_Producer_Layout runs) (room : PV_RJN_Producer_FrontRoom runs) :
    PV_RJN_NodeContext.PV_RJN_Link_PublishOrder runs := by
  intro query node i p proof fields range context success
  obtain ⟨sz,op,nd,mg,tg,hsz,hop,hnd,hmg,htg,hpsize,hpop,hpnd,hheader⟩ := layout i
  obtain ⟨size,openings,nodes,magic,tag,h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7,h8,h9,ib,cc1,cc2,semanticResult,valuesResult,
    hsize,hmagic,htag,hh0,hh1,hsem,hclaim,hib,hh4,hh5,hh6,hh7,hh8,hopen,hopenlen,
    hc1,hc2,hh9,hnodes,hnodelen,hn,hprooflen⟩ := PV_RJN_PublishTrace.source .S2 p proof success
  have esz := Result.ok.inj (hsz.symm.trans hsize)
  have eop := Result.ok.inj (hop.symm.trans hopen)
  have end1 := Result.ok.inj (hnd.symm.trans hnodes)
  have emg := Result.ok.inj (hmg.symm.trans hmagic)
  have etg := Result.ok.inj (htg.symm.trans htag)
  subst sz; subst op; subst nd; subst mg; subst tg
  have h0bytes : bytes h0.val=bytes magic.val := by
    have h := PV_RJN_Bytes.append_success _ _ _ hh0
    change h0.val=[]++magic.val at h
    simpa only [List.nil_append] using congrArg bytes h
  have h1bytes : bytes h1.val=(runs i).plan.header := by
    have h := congrArg bytes (PV_RJN_Bytes.append_success _ _ _ hh1)
    rw [PV_RJN_Bytes.append,h0bytes] at h
    exact h.trans hheader.symm
  have hfields := fields
  obtain ⟨hc0,hc1bytes,hfbytes,hsemantic,hvalues,hroot,hinactive⟩ := fields
  have len1 : h1.val.length=(runs i).plan.header.length := by
    rw [← PV_RJN_Bytes.length h1.val,h1bytes]
  have room1 : h1.length+(runs i).plan.semantic.length≤Usize.max := by
    change h1.val.length+_≤_
    have := room i
    omega
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hsv⟩ := hsemantic h1 room1
  have he : s=h2 := by
    have := Result.ok.inj (hs.symm.trans hsem)
    exact Prod.mk.inj this |>.2
  subst s
  have h2bytes : bytes h2.val=(runs i).plan.header++(runs i).plan.semantic := by
    rw [hsv,h1bytes]
  have len2 : h2.val.length=(runs i).plan.header.length+(runs i).plan.semantic.length := by
    rw [← PV_RJN_Bytes.length h2.val,h2bytes,List.length_append]
  have room2 : h2.length+(runs i).plan.claim.length≤Usize.max := by
    change h2.val.length+_≤_
    rw [len2]
    exact room i
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hsv⟩ := hvalues h2 room2
  have he : s=h3 := by
    have := Result.ok.inj (hs.symm.trans hclaim)
    exact Prod.mk.inj this |>.2
  subst s
  have h3bytes : bytes h3.val=(runs i).plan.header++(runs i).plan.semantic++(runs i).plan.claim := by
    rw [hsv,h2bytes]
  obtain ⟨ib',hib',hibv⟩ := hinactive
  have eib := Result.ok.inj (hib'.symm.trans hib)
  subst ib'
  have h4bytes := congrArg bytes (PV_RJN_Bytes.append_success _ _ _ hh4)
  have h5bytes := congrArg bytes (PV_RJN_Bytes.append_success _ _ _ hh5)
  have h6bytes := congrArg bytes (PV_RJN_Bytes.append_success _ _ _ hh6)
  have h7bytes := congrArg bytes (PV_RJN_Bytes.append_success _ _ _ hh7)
  have h8bytes := congrArg bytes (PV_RJN_Bytes.append_success _ _ _ hh8)
  have frontbytes : bytes h8.val=front (runs i) := by
    simp only [PV_RJN_Bytes.append] at h4bytes h5bytes h6bytes h7bytes h8bytes
    change bytes h4.val=bytes h3.val++bytes ib.val at h4bytes
    change bytes h5.val=bytes h4.val++bytes p.c0bytes.val at h5bytes
    change bytes h6.val=bytes h5.val++bytes p.root.val at h6bytes
    change bytes h7.val=bytes h6.val++bytes p.c1bytes.val at h7bytes
    change bytes h8.val=bytes h7.val++bytes p.fbytes.val at h8bytes
    rw [h8bytes,h7bytes,h6bytes,h5bytes,h4bytes,h3bytes,hibv,hc0,hc1bytes,hfbytes,hroot]
    rfl
  have offopen : h8.length=(runs i).plan.offOpenings := by rw [hpop]; exact congrArg UScalar.val hopenlen
  obtain ⟨_,hq⟩ := query i p hfields range context
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqv⟩ := hq h8 cc1 cc2 hc1 hc2 offopen
  have eq := Result.ok.inj (hq.symm.trans hh9)
  subst q
  have querybytes : ProverCommitPublish43.queries (runs i).plan.queries (front (runs i))=bytes h9.val := by
    rw [← frontbytes]
    exact hqv.symm
  have offnode : h9.length=(runs i).plan.offNodes := by rw [hpnd]; exact congrArg UScalar.val hnodelen
  have model := (node i p hfields range context).2.2 h9 cc1 cc2 hc1 hc2 offnode
  rw [hn] at model
  change some (bytes proof.val)=exceptBytes _ at model
  have slots : ProverCommitPublish43.slots (runs i).plan.slots (bytes h9.val)=.ok (bytes proof.val) := by
    cases hs : ProverCommitPublish43.slots (runs i).plan.slots (bytes h9.val) with
    | error e => rw [hs] at model; cases model
    | ok b =>
      rw [hs] at model
      have hb := Option.some.inj model
      exact congrArg Except.ok hb.symm
  have nodeLen : (bytes h9.val).length=(runs i).plan.offNodes := by
    rw [PV_RJN_Bytes.length]
    exact offnode
